data.title: SOC Design Engineer
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

 

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.




THE ROLE:

An RTL design and integration role in our System on Chip (SoC) design team, where numerous subsystems and IP cores are integrated to produce high performance SoC products. Our designers work on SoC level RTL design, block level RTL design, and/or subsystem level integration for a variety of SoC products.  Your expertise will be deployed in SoC ASIC projects targeting networking, security, storage, and other applications.

 

THE PERSON:

You are an experienced RTL designer who has a passion for modern digital ASIC design. You are a team player who has excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience collaborating across multiple design sites and time zones. You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and enjoy tackling new challenges.  You pay attention to details. You enjoy working amongst a multi-disciplinary team of professionals with diverse skills and experiences to complete projects in an efficient manner.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 

  • Develop and maintain SoC and subsystems synthesizable RTL, design methodology and infrastructure
  • Collaborate directly with IP Architecture, SoC Architecture and Design Leads
  • Debug and resolve issues with SoC Integration, SoC Design Verification and post-silicon validation teams
  • Work with IP development teams and Physical Design (PD) team to meet SoC Power/Performance/Area goals by providing synthesis and timing closure support
  • Resolve SoC simulation regression failures through close collaboration with SoC Verification Team and working with Verification Team members to ensure achievement of verification quality metrics
  • Support the activities of the Emulation Team
  • Attend and contribute to regular technical status meetings

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

 

  • Experienced RTL (Verilog / System Verilog) ASIC design experience through implementations targeting leading edge ASIC technologies
  • Proven experience with industry-leading ASIC design tools, synthesis tools, flows, and timing closure
  • Experience executing design checks such as lint, CDC, and LEC using industry standard ASIC tools
  • Familiarity with industry standard power flows
  • Proficient with scripting languages such as Python, Perl, TCL, Makefile, and csh/bash
  • Skilled in simulation and debugging with functional verification tools from Synopsys, Cadence, and/or Siemens (Mentor) including Gate-level simulations
  • Industry experience with ASIC SoC design and integration
  • Excellent understanding of standard bus/interface protocols (i.e. AXI, AHB, AMBA)
  • Experience in modern, complex networking architecture and digital design in general
  • Familiarity with networking protocols (such as Ethernet) and standards for digital communication systems, optical communications, and packet processing applications
  • Familiarity with encryption protocols (such as MACsec and IPsec) and security technologies for digital communication systems 

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer/Electrical Engineering

data.title: Technical Program Manager- AI Cluster Validation
data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING 

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.  Together, we advance your career.  




THE ROLE

We are seeking a Technical Program Manager to lead execution of AI cluster engineering programs with deep focus on GPU platforms, rack-level solutions, and AI Cluster validation. This role is responsible for driving end-to-end delivery from GPU + server integration through rack bring-up, scale testing, failure analysis, and system debug closure, ensuring platform readiness for hyperscale and enterprise AI deployments.

This role operates at the intersection of hardware, firmware, networking, and scale-test execution, and requires strong technical depth combined with disciplined program execution.

 

THE PERSON

You are a hands-on TPM who thrives in complex, fast-moving ecosystems, and can connect deep technical details to crisp program plans, executive reporting, and customer outcomes. You are comfortable driving execution in bring-up and EVT/DVT/PVT working closely with engineers to root-cause issues, unblock debug, and make data-driven tradeoffs to keep programs moving. You bring urgency, ownership, and clarity to ambiguous problem spaces and can communicate effectively from lab floor to executive review.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

Program Leadership & Execution

  • Define, plan, and drive program plans for AI infrastructure systems validation and readiness, including server integration, rack bring-up, and cluster-scale deployment readiness.
  • Create and maintain core PM artifacts: schedules, dependency maps, resource forecasts, risk/issue logs, and program dashboards/status reports.
  • Identify and drive mitigation plans for issues/risks, including cross-team escalations and corrective actions across multiple engineering areas.
  • Drive regular execution reviews with engineering teams and provide concise, data-driven updates to senior leadership.

 

GPU & Platform Execution

  • Own program execution for GPU-based AI platforms, spanning system bring-up, qualification, scale readiness, and deployment validation across server, rack, and cluster levels.
  • Drive alignment across GPU, CPU, firmware, BIOS/BMC, and system teams to ensure readiness for scale testing and customer workloads.
  • Track platform issues, and debug dependencies; ensure risks are clearly documented, owned, and mitigated.

 

AI Rack / Cluster Validation

  • Own program planning and execution for multi-node and multi-rack scale testing, including test strategy, scheduling, coverage tracking, and readiness gates.
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of rack-level AI solutions, including compute trays, switch trays, cabling, power, cooling, and management infrastructure.
  • Ensure rack bring-up plans are executable, resourced, and gated with clear entry/exit criteria across EVT, DVT, and scale phases.
  • Drive coordination across lab operations, infrastructure, and engineering teams to unblock rack access, power, networking, and test readiness.
  • Partner with scale, performance, and automation teams to ensure workloads, stress tests, and regressions plans are ready before hardware arrives.

 

Debug, Failure Analysis & Risk Management

  • Act as the execution lead for platform debug, coordinating across engineering teams to ensure fast triage, root-cause analysis, and resolution of system-level issues.
  • Track high-impact failures (GPU, HSIO, FW, rack, network) through debug forums ensuring clear ownership and closure plans.
  • Balance debug depth vs. program timelines, escalating tradeoffs when needed and ensuring leadership has a clear view of risk and impact.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience leading complex hardware or AI infrastructure programs with ownership across bring-up, validation, and deployment phases.
  • Strong technical understanding of GPU-based AI systems, rack architectures, and datacenter infrastructure.
  • Proven ability to manage ambiguity, drive debug execution, and lead cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level status reporting.
  • Proficiency with program management and execution tools (Jira, Confluence, dashboards, Excel/PowerPoint).

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Hands-on experience with GPU cluster scale testing, system stress, or performance validation.
  • Familiarity with rack-level bring-up, power/cooling constraints, networking, and failure modes at scale.
  • Experience working through hardware/firmware debug cycles in pre-production or customer-facing environments.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree systems, EE, CS, or related engineering discipline.

LOCATION: Austin, TX

 

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

 

#LI-CS1

data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING 

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.  Together, we advance your career.  




THE ROLE:

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist to lead initiatives in advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and generative AI for our Sales Operations org. This role combines statistical expertise, machine learning, and cutting-edge generative models to deliver actionable insights that drive strategic decisions across multiple business areas. As part of our team, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize revenue, improve operations, and empower sales and marketing professionals by leveraging data-driven solutions and AI to minimize manual tasks, enabling them to focus more efficiently on selling products.

 

THE PERSON:

The person we are looking for should have passion in data science. He/she has strong SQL and programming skills (Python is preferred) and has a good understanding of statistics and machine learning algorithms.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Predictive Modeling & Machine Learning:
    • Develop and deploy predictive models using machine learning algorithms (e.g., XGBoost, Random Forest) to address business challenges such as customer segmentation and revenue forecast.
    • Build end-to-end ML pipelines from data ingestion to model deployment, ensuring scalability and reliability.
  • Time-Series Forecasting:
    • Create robust time-series forecasting models for revenue, demand, and operational metrics using techniques like ARIMA, Prophet, Bayesian methods, and hybrid approaches.
    • Partner with finance, sales, and operations teams to integrate forecasts into strategic planning and decision-making processes.
  • Generative AI & Advanced Analytics:
    • Design and implement generative AI solutions (e.g., LLMs, GANs) for business applications such as information retrieval, workflow automation, and AI-driven decision systems.

Data Pipeline & Infrastructure:

    • Collaborate with data engineering teams to design and maintain scalable data pipelines using tools like Airflow, KNIME, or custom shell scripting.
    • Leverage big data frameworks (e.g., Snowflake, Hadoop, Spark) for efficient data processing and storage.
  • Exploratory Data Analysis & Visualization:
    • Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns and insights from structured and unstructured data sources.
    • Develop visualizations using tools such as Plotly, Matplotlib and Seaborn to communicate findings effectively to stakeholders.
  • Collaboration & Impact Measurement:
    • Work closely with business leaders, data engineers, and BI teams to align on business needs and deliver impactful solutions.
    • Monitor model performance post-deployment and iterate on models to ensure continued business impact.
  • Continuous Learning & Innovation:
    • Stay updated on emerging technologies in AI, machine learning, and generative models.
    • Experiment with new tools and techniques to enhance team capabilities and drive innovation.

 

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Education:
    Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Technical Skills:
    • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and other programming languages.
    • Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms and statistical techniques.
    • Hands-on experience with ML libraries (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) and frameworks for generative AI.
    • Familiarity with time-series forecasting methods and tools.
    • Experience working with big data technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Hadoop, Spark).
    • Basic knowledge of UNIX shell scripting (Bash, Zsh).
  • Experience:
    • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in data science or related fields.
    • Demonstrated ability to deliver end-to-end ML projects from start to finish.
    • Experience with version control tools like Git and GitHub.
  • Business Acumen:
    • Ability to translate technical insights into actionable business strategies.
    • Strong communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Austin, TX

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. THE ROLE:

Supply Chain Manager who owns and maintains production supply modeling for Server and NTSG products. This role will influence across functions & regions (Engineering, Business Unit, Contract Manufacturers, Customer Operations, Logistics) using sophisticated product planning, analytical and problem-solving skills. 

 

THE PERSON:

The Supply Chain Manager will be recognized as the product planning lead, and they will drive outstanding processes, reporting and communication on a global scale. You should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and nimble and adaptable to the changing AI marketplace. You should also have executive level presentation skills, and strong organizational, problem-solving & analytical skills.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own and maintain product supply plans and coordinates execution
  • Project/forecast supplies across suppliers with cross collaboration internally and externally
  • Collaborate with the Business Unit to adapt and match customer demand within modeled weekly capacity as demand mix changes

  • Integrated Product Planning: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and execute the target revenue attainment.
  • Collaborate on risk management strategies to address potential disruptions and ensure production continuity
  • Tactical Product Planning: Influence supply commits weekly
  • Partner with Customer Operations and/or Global Logistics to address customer escalations and supply commit adjustments
  • Drive robust tool development to manage complex planning, BOM, and inventory flows
  • Advocate and drive continuous improvement & change management process design to increase team’s productivity and scale.

  • Knowledge of semiconductor and electronics (PCBA) manufacturing environment
  • Advanced supply chain analysis skills, as well as advanced Excel, writing macros, PowerBI and SQL skills

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate at all levels of the organization.

THE ROLE:

AMD Serdes Technology Group develops high-performance electrical and optical transceivers in advanced CMOS PDKs. We are seeking an expert in analog/mixed-signal circuit design and architecture.

 

THE PERSON:

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in advanced ultra-high-speed electrical and/or optical PHY design.  She/He needs to be a self-starter who collaborates well with various functional teams and customers to successfully drive projects to completion.

 

KEY RESPONSIBLITIES:

  • To own performance-critical analog mixed-signal circuit blocks used in Serdes, such as high-speed data converters (DAC and ADC), clocking (reference clock, PLL, clock dividers, mixers, buffers, regulators, multi-phase clock generators, error detection and correction), and analog front-end circuits (pad matching networks, ESD, CTLE, linear amplifier)

  • To work with pre-tapeout verification and post-silicon validation teams to bring up silicon and analyze silicon results

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:  

  • Experience designing 200G+ CMOS transceivers, with a deep understanding of high-speed electrical and/or optical interface requirements.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in hands-on circuit optimizations, including tuning for power, performance, and area at both block and system levels.
  • Proven track record in silicon productization—from initial design through to bring-up, validation, and successful ramp to mass production.

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

THE ROLE :

AMD is seeking a Senior Manager of Media Relations to drive proactive storytelling in the Global Communications team. This person will identify the agenda setting stories that need to be told, map them to the right reporters and influencers, and manage the work to land them. Part of this role will include building and deepening relationships with reporters and influencers and collaborating across the Global comms team to educate and influence these people . This person will own proactive engagement, ensuring that AMD’s differentiated narrative is widely and accurately understood, that the company is well positioned versus competitors, and volume of coverage increases outside of company moments. 

 

THE PERSON :

The ideal candidate is a sharp storyteller and relationship-builder who thrives at the intersection of deep technology and compelling narrative, and who can position AMD as the preeminent leader in the semiconductor industry. They must also be a strong team player, able to work across the global comms team and navigate strong existing relationships, and with teams across the business including technical, financial, and customer focused. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and pitch stories. Craft compelling, differentiated stories and proactively pitch them to corporate and top tech media and influencers, securing coverage that drives awareness, influence, and action across key audiences. 
  • Run a program for the ‘moments in between the moments’. Run an always on big stories motion to ensure that AMD is featured in the media outside of key moments like product launches, earnings and company events. 
  • Build and deepen relationships. Develop, nurture, and deepen relationships with the journalists and influencers covering AMD and the broader AI and semiconductor landscape. Serve as a trusted, go-to resource who educates the media on AMD’s technology, strategy, and point of view. 
  • Collaborate across the comms team to drive impact and best practice: Partner with PR leads in their key moments to provide media and influencer strategy and ensure the best possible outcomes for each moment 
  • Monitor the landscape. Continuously track the media and influencer landscape to understand coverage trends, identify emerging voices, anticipate narrative risks and opportunities, and inform AMD’s engagement strategy. 
  • Drive a best-in-class program across key moments. Partner across the PR and broader communications team to ensure AMD has a stellar media and influencer relations program spanning all of our most important moments — including industry events, product launches, quarterly earnings, and corporate announcements. 
  • Prepare the team and executives. Ensure AMD’s communications team and executives are consistently well prepared for media and influencer engagements, including briefings, messaging, and Q&A readiness. 
  • Champion AMD’s narrative. Ensure AMD’s differentiated story is consistently and widely covered, reinforcing AMD’s position as a preeminent leader in the semiconductor industry. 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Significant experience in media relations strategy, influencer relations, PR, or corporate communications, ideally within technology, semiconductors, or another fast-moving, technically complex industry. 
  • A proven track record of building strong relationships with top-tier media and influencers and consistently securing high-impact coverage. 
  • Exceptional storytelling, writing, and pitching skills, with the ability to translate complex technology into clear, compelling narratives. 
  • Strong news judgment and a deep understanding of the media and influencer landscape. 
  • Experience supporting executives and preparing spokespeople for high-stakes engagements. 
  • A collaborative, cross-functional approach and the ability to operate effectively across major company moments, including product launches and earnings.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

 

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.




THE ROLE:

We are seeking a hands-on AI/ML developer to build, scale and deploy the next generation AI-assisted silicon design framework. This role sits at the intersection of production software engineering, AI orchestration, and hardware infrastructure, enabling acceleration of the specification-to-netlist lifecycle.

In this role, you will design and develop a robust, modular agentic ecosystem where specialized AI agents leverage advanced reasoning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and structured tool execution to support complex IP development tasks. You will collaborate closely with IP and SoC teams to transform AI prototypes into reliable, enterprise-grade engineering solutions.

 

THE PERSON:

The ideal candidate is a pragmatic AI/ML engineer with a strong systems mindset who prioritizes robustness, predictability, and scalability over experimental AI demonstrations. They are detail-oriented and deeply focused on deterministic guardrails, error handling, and performance optimization. This individual will build credibility quickly with hardware engineering teams by understanding the rigor required for silicon production and approaches challenges with a focus on making AI-driven workflows auditable, reliable, and production-ready.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and deploy modular AI agent architectures capable of task decomposition, structured tool usage, and iterative code generation across the spec-to-RTL lifecycle
  • Develop and optimize multi-step agent workflows, including prompt orchestration, context management, and state handling for complex engineering tasks
  • Build and scale hybrid retrieval systems, including RAG pipelines and knowledge graphs, to ground AI agents in hardware specifications, protocols, and architectural data
  • Develop closed-loop automation systems that enable AI agents to interpret and respond to compiler errors and EDA tool outputs (e.g., lint, simulation) for iterative design refinement
  • Build and maintain secure, low-latency infrastructure to integrate LLMs with external tools using Model Context Protocol (MCP) and custom APIs
  • Partner with IP and Subsystem teams to integrate AI-driven workflows into existing silicon development processes
  • Establish evaluation frameworks and automated pipelines to validate AI-generated outputs for correctness, synthesis readiness, and power, performance, and area (PPA) targets

 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience developing production-grade AI/LLM applications and agent-based systems
  • Hands-on experience with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar graph-based agent architectures
  • Strong understanding of API development and integrating LLMs with external systems and tools
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar tool-calling frameworks
  • Foundational understanding of silicon IP design and verification workflows, including exposure to Verilog/SystemVerilog or digital design concepts
  • Familiarity with EDA tools (e.g., Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens) and Linux-based development environments
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python, C++, Go, or similar languages, with experience building scalable, secure, and modular systems

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

  • Belgrade, Serbia

data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING 

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.  Together, we advance your career.  




THE ROLE:    

As a core member of the team, you will play a pivotal role in optimizing and developing deep learning frameworks for AMD GPUs. Your work will be instrumental in enhancing GPU kernel performance, accelerating deep learning models, and enabling training and inference at scale across multi-GPU and multi-node systems. You will collaborate across internal GPU software teams and engage with open-source communities to integrate cutting-edge compiler technologies and drive upstream contributions that benefit AMD’s AI software ecosystem. 

 

THE PERSON:   

Skilled engineer with strong technical and analytical expertise in C++ development within Linux environments. The ideal candidate will thrive in both collaborative team settings and independent work, with the ability to define goals, manage development efforts, and deliver high-quality solutions. Strong problem-solving skills, a proactive approach, and a keen understanding of software engineering best practices are essential. 

   

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:   

  • Optimize Deep Learning Frameworks: Enhance performance of frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and SGLang on AMD GPUs via upstream contributions in open-source repositories. 
  • Develop and Optimize Deep Learning Models: Profile and tune large-scale training and inference models for optimal performance on AMD hardware. 
  • GPU Kernel Development: Design, implement, and optimize high-performance GPU kernels using HIP, Triton, or other relevant tools for AI operator efficiency. 
  • Collaborate with GPU Library and Compiler Teams: Work closely with internal compiler and GPU math library teams to integrate and align kernel-level optimizations with full-stack performance goals. 
  • Contribute to SGLang Development: Support optimization, feature development, and scaling of the SGLang LLM framework across AMD GPU platforms. 
  • Distributed System Optimization: Tune and scale performance across both multi-GPU (scale-up) and multi-node (scale-out) environments, including inference parallelism and collective communication strategies. 
  • Graph Compiler Integration: Integrate and optimize runtime execution through graph compilers such as XLA, TorchDynamo, or custom pipelines. 
  • Open-Source Collaboration: Partner with external maintainers to understand framework needs, propose optimizations, and upstream contributions effectively. 
  • Apply Engineering Best Practices: Leverage modern software engineering practices in debugging, profiling, test-driven development, and CI integration. 

 PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:   

  • Strong Programming Skills: Expert in C++ and/or Python, with demonstrated ability to debug, profile, and optimize performance-critical code. 
  • SGLang and LLM Optimization: Solid hands-on experience with SGLang or similar LLM inference frameworks is highly preferred. 
  • Compiler and GPU Architecture Knowledge: Background in compiler design or familiarity with technologies like LLVM, MLIR, or ROCm is a plus. 
  • Heterogeneous System Workloads: Expert experience running and scaling workloads on large-scale, heterogeneous clusters (CPU + GPU) using distributed training or inference strategies. 
  • AI Framework Integration: Strong experience and contribution to or integrating optimizations into deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. 
  • GPU Computing: Solid and strong knowledge of HIP, CUDA, or other GPU programming models; experience with GCN/CDNA architecture preferred. 

 

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:   

  • Bachelor’s and/or Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING 

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.  Together, we advance your career.  




 

THE ROLE:

As a Browser Optimization Engineer, you will play a critical role in driving real-world browser performance improvements across Chromium-based platforms. Working at the intersection of browser engines, operating systems, and hardware, you will identify and resolve performance bottlenecks that directly impact millions of users.

This role offers the opportunity to work deeply within Chromium subsystems such as Blink, V8, Skia, and GPU layers, while collaborating with browser, OS, compiler, and silicon teams to deliver measurable, user-visible gains. You will operate in a highly collaborative, systems-focused environment where your work translates directly into faster, more responsive web experiences.

THE PERSON:

You are a performance-focused engineer who enjoys digging into complex systems and uncovering root causes of inefficiency. You are naturally curious, data-driven, and comfortable working across large, multi-layered codebases.

You thrive in collaborative environments, working effectively with cross-functional teams spanning software, operating systems, and hardware. You communicate clearly, translate technical insights into actionable improvements, and are motivated by delivering measurable impact to end users.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Profile and optimize performance across Chromium subsystems, including Blink, V8, Skia, GPU/ANGLE, and browser multi-process architecture
  • Identify CPU, memory, GPU, and power bottlenecks using real-world workloads, benchmarks, and telemetry
  • Implement improvements in areas such as page load performance, rendering, JavaScript execution, graphics/compositing, and responsiveness
  • Drive cross-platform optimizations, with a primary focus on Windows and exposure to Linux/macOS environments
  • Analyze system behavior using tools such as Perfetto, ETW, Chrome Tracing, VTune, PIX, GPUView, and perf
  • Collaborate with browser vendors, OS teams, compiler teams, and hardware partners to co-optimize software and platforms
  • Contribute high-quality patches to Chromium or related codebases where appropriate
  • Translate low-level profiling insights into scalable, user-facing performance improvements
  • Document findings and communicate results clearly to technical stakeholders

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong background in software engineering with a focus on performance optimization
  • Experience working with Chromium or Chromium-based browsers (e.g., Chrome, Edge, or internal forks)
  • Proficiency in C++ and modern performance-oriented development practices
  • Understanding of browser internals across areas such as:
    • Rendering pipelines (e.g., Blink lifecycle, layout, paint)
    • JavaScript engines (e.g., V8, JIT behavior, garbage collection)
    • Graphics and compositing (e.g., Skia, GPU rasterization, ANGLE, WebGL)
    • Multi-process architectures and IPC models
  • Experience using profiling and tracing tools to drive optimization decisions
  • Strong debugging skills within large-scale, complex systems
  • Ability to connect microarchitectural behavior (cache, memory, SIMD, branching) to real-world performance outcomes
  • Familiarity with Windows performance analysis (including ETW) and graphics stack interactions
  • Exposure to Clang/LLVM and compiler-driven optimizations
  • Experience with performance benchmarks such as JetStream, Speedometer, WebXPRT, or MotionMark
  • Awareness of hardware-aware optimization techniques (CPU topology, cache behavior, SIMD/AVX, GPU execution models)
  • Experience contributing to large-scale or open-source codebases
  • Ability to mentor others and influence performance best practices across teams

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field preferred

As a key contributor to designing AMD’s AI server product, you will be part of a board design team to work with a cross-functional team to design and deliver the highest-quality proposal/product to the customer. You will be responsible for creating quality and ensuring the success of teamwork. You and the team will continue to develop, and the product will improve. We also encourage technical innovation to showcase successes and facilitate continuous career development.

  • Cross-functional work ability – able to work with functions to design AMD AI product solutions.

Senior SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER  

  

THE ROLE: 

AMD is seeking an experienced **Static Timing Analysis (STA) Engineer** to join our high-performance Cores team. This role will be responsible for ensuring timing closure and optimization of next-generation CPU/APU designs operating at industry-leading frequencies. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in STA methodologies, timing marginings, and yield analysis for advanced process nodes.

 

THE PERSON:  

     As an STA Engineer in the AMD Cores team, you will play a critical role in delivering high-frequency, power-efficient processor designs that push the boundaries of performance. You will work closely with RTL design, physical design, and verification teams to ensure robust timing closure across multiple process corners and operating conditions.

  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:  

  • 2+ years of experience in Static Timing Analysis for high-performance digital designs
  • 2+ years** working on CPU, GPU, or high-frequency ASIC designs
  • Proven track record of leading timing closure for complex SoCs through multiple tapeouts

Timing Closure & Analysis

  •     Lead static timing analysis for high-frequency CPU/APU cores running at 4+ GHz
  •     Perform comprehensive timing signoff across all PVT corners (SS, TT, FF, FS, SF) and voltage/temperature combinations
  •     Drive timing closure from RTL freeze through tapeout, ensuring all setup, hold, and transition violations are resolved
  •     Develop and maintain timing constraints (SDC) for complex clocking architectures including multi-mode, multi-corner scenarios
  •     Analyze and optimize critical paths to achieve frequency targets while minimizing power impact
  •     Perform timing ECO (Engineering Change Orders) and coordinate with physical design teams for implementation

 Timing Marginings & Variability Analysis

  • Define and implement timing margins for process variation, voltage droop, aging, temperature gradients, and OCV (On-Chip Variation)
  • Conduct **statistical timing analysis (STA/SSTA)** to account for process variation and ensure robust yield
  • Perform **AOCV/POCV/SOCV** analysis for advanced nodes (5nm, 3nm and beyond)
  • Develop methodologies for **IR drop analysis** and voltage-aware timing closure
  • Analyze **aging effects** (NBTI, HCI, EM) and define appropriate timing guardbands
  • Work with characterization teams to define **derating factors** and timing models

 Yield Analysis & Optimization

  • Collaborate with yield engineering teams to analyze timing yield and identify sensitivities
  • Perform path-based analysis (PBA) and graph-based analysis (GBA) to reduce pessimism
  • Conduct Monte Carlo simulations and corner analysis to ensure robust timing across process spread
  • Identify and optimize timing-critical structures to improve manufacturability
  • Drive binning strategies based on frequency and voltage guardband analysis

  

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:  

 

Physical Design Exposure

  • Physical design experience (synthesis, place & route, or timing closure)
  • Understanding of placement optimization for timing improvement
  • Knowledge of routing impacts on timing (via count, metal layer selection, wire models)
  • Experience with floorplanning and its impact on timing
  • Familiarity with physical design tools: Synopsys Fusion Compiler, Cadence Innovus/Genus
  • Understanding of buffer insertion and gate sizing strategies
  • Knowledge of pin assignment and I/O timing closure

Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS) Recipes

  • Experience **defining CTS recipes** and specifications for clock tree builders
  • Deep understanding of **CTS algorithms**: H-tree, X-tree, fishbone, mesh
  • Knowledge of **clock buffer selection** and sizing for skew/latency optimization
  • Experience with **useful skew** implementation and optimization
  • Understanding of **clock concurrent optimization (CCOpt)**
  • Familiarity with **clock tree QoR metrics**: insertion delay, skew, transition, power  

Additional Preferred Skills

  • Experience with **Synopsys tools**: Design Compiler, IC Compiler II, PrimeTime SI/PX
  • Knowledge of **machine learning** applications in timing prediction and optimization
  • Familiarity with **FinFET** and **Gate-All-Around (GAA)** transistor timing characteristics
  • Understanding of **3D IC** and chiplet-based timing analysis
  • Experience with **timing correlation** studies between STA and SPICE
  • Knowledge of **standard cell characterization** and timing library generation

  

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:  

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING 

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.  Together, we advance your career.  




THE ROLE:

AMD’s Software and Solutions Team is seeking an Agentic AI Systems Architecture Fellow to define the architectural vision and technical strategy for next-generation Agentic AI systems built on AMD’s heterogeneous computing portfolio. This is a rare opportunity to take deep, hard-won expertise — wherever you built it — and channel it directly into what AMD is building today and where the company is headed next, shaping end-to-end AI workflows that seamlessly leverage AMD CPUs, GPUs, DPUs, networking, and software platforms to deliver secure, scalable, deterministic, and high-performance AI solutions.

 

The Fellow will establish AMD’s technical strategy for Agentic AI while developing innovative, real-world use cases that demonstrate the capabilities of AMD platforms through internal implementations and early customer proof-of-concepts (PoCs). By integrating frontier foundation models, intelligent orchestration frameworks, heterogeneous compute scheduling, and data-centric optimization across enterprise, cloud, sovereign AI, and edge deployments, the Fellow will accelerate adoption of AMD AI technologies while validating next-generation architectural approaches in production-oriented environments — turning personal expertise into AMD’s forward momentum.

 

Working across AMD’s AI software ecosystem — including AMD + AMD (A+A) and AMD + NVIDIA (A+N) environments — and leveraging technologies such as ROCm™, AMD Zen Software Studio, AMD Enterprise AI, and AMD’s open-source software initiatives, the Fellow will define reference architectures focused on execution, performance, and efficiency, while also considering data integrity, security, and governance. These architectures will help AMD customers deploy trusted, scalable, production-ready AI solutions while influencing AMD silicon and software roadmaps to maintain aggressive innovation and market leadership.

 

As a recognized technical authority, this individual will collaborate with product engineering, silicon architecture, software organizations, customers, hyperscalers, ISVs, open-source communities, and industry partners to shape the future of Agentic AI computing. This is a highly technical individual contributor role focused on architectural innovation, technical strategy, and execution — not a people management, program management, or alliance management position.

 

THE PERSON:

A recognized industry expert with deep expertise spanning Agentic AI systems architecture, heterogeneous AI infrastructure, and AI performance engineering — the three defining pillars of this role. AMD is especially interested in architects with strong CPU-based platform backgrounds: this role is not GPU-only, and candidates who bring deep CPU systems expertise alongside AI fluency are highly encouraged to apply. You don’t need to be an expert in every domain — heterogeneous computing, distributed systems, intelligent data architectures, operating systems, cloud/Neo Cloud, networking, and security are all valuable, but your strongest platform (CPU or GPU) combined with AI systems depth is what matters most.

 

The ideal candidate understands how frontier foundation models, agentic reasoning systems, orchestration frameworks, and heterogeneous compute resources interact to deliver scalable, deterministic, and production-ready AI systems, and thrives shaping long-term strategy while staying hands-on in architectural innovation and performance engineering.

The Role:

AMD's NBIO (Northbridge I/O) organization is seeking an experienced ASIC Formal Verification Architect to join the IOHUB team. This team develops industry-leading I/O connectivity, virtualization, and infrastructure technologies that power next-generation data center, AI/ML, client, graphics, embedded, and semi-custom products.

As an ASIC Formal Verification Architect, you will play a critical role in defining and executing formal verification strategies for complex IP and SoC designs. Working closely with architects, designers, and verification teams, you will drive verification planning, methodology development, infrastructure architecture, and sign-off activities while leading a team of engineers to deliver high-quality silicon solutions.

This position offers the opportunity to influence verification methodology across multiple projects, mentor engineers, and help shape the future of AMD's formal verification capabilities.

 

The Person:

The ideal candidate is a technical leader with deep expertise in formal verification methodologies and a passion for solving complex design and verification challenges. You thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and can effectively drive projects from concept through verification closure.

You possess:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail
  • Proven leadership experience guiding technical teams and mentoring engineers
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills
  • Self-motivation with the ability to independently drive initiatives to completion
  • A continuous improvement mindset and passion for technical innovation
  • The ability to balance multiple priorities in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead and mentor a team of formal verification engineers across multiple IP and SoC projects
  • Define and drive formal verification architecture, methodologies, and development plans in partnership with IP architects and design teams
  • Develop comprehensive formal verification test plans and execute verification closure strategies
  • Architect, develop, and maintain reusable formal verification environments, properties, components, and infrastructure
  • Drive adoption of industry-leading formal verification methodologies and best practices across the organization
  • Perform formal connectivity verification, deadlock/livelock analysis, and protocol verification for complex I/O and arbitration-intensive designs
  • Apply advanced formal techniques, including abstraction, decomposition, and assume-guarantee methodologies, to solve challenging verification problems
  • Debug and triage failures identified through formal verification tools and root-cause complex design issues
  • Collaborate closely with design, validation, and post-silicon teams to reproduce and resolve functional issues
  • Contribute to verification sign-off activities and ensure delivery of high-quality silicon solutions
  • Foster technical excellence through coaching, mentorship, and knowledge sharing across the team

Preferred Experience:

  • Strong understanding of digital design and computer architecture
  • Verification skills: Formal verification (Static and Dynamic), Assertion based verification, FPV and DPV
  • Experience with CDC and RDC formal verification methodologies; proficiency with JasperGold CDC/RDC and Connectivity apps strongly preferred
  • Experience with sequential/logical equivalence checking (SEC/LEC)
  • Ability to apply abstraction, decomposition, and assume-guarantee reasoning to tackle intractable formal problems at scale
  • Strong Design debug, Deep bug hunting skills
  • Formal test planning, Formal tools – Jasper, VC-formal.
  • Design knowledge of CPU, GPU, Bus/Noc/Interconnect, Memory Controllers, Cache preferred
  • Familiarity with UVM-based simulation environments and experience bridging formal and simulation-based verification flows
  • System Verilog, Verilog or VHDL, Scripting skills are an asset.

 

Academic Credentials:

  • BS/MS degree in Engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Computer) or Computer Science.

data.description:
WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING 

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.  Together, we advance your career.  




THE ROLE:

 

Join us at the forefront of AI. As a Sr. Rack and Chassis Design Mechanical Engineer, you'll lead the design and build the physical backbone that powers next-generation AI, from cutting-edge AI servers and high-density infrastructure to advanced liquid cooling solutions. This is a rare opportunity to solve some of the most demanding thermal and mechanical challenges in the industry, working on systems that push the boundaries of what's possible in modern computing.

 

Our high-impact Mechanical Design and Development team has an opportunity for a Sr. Rack and Chassis Design Mechanical Engineer at our labs in Austin, TX. Our team is focused on the mechanical development of AMD’s advanced server products and platforms, and your work will span from early-stage concept development through product commercialization, involving both pre- and post-silicon activities, and you will.   

  • Lead the mechanical design and highly influence mechanical architecture for AMD’s flagship server and GPU products used in leading-edge data centers worldwide.
  • Work alongside experts in mechanical, thermal, and structural design and shape the future of high-performance computing hardware.
  • Strong collaboration across diverse technical teams to drive decisions and solve highly complex engineering challenges to deliver robust, manufacturable solutions that meet stringent  performance and reliability goals.
  • Be part of a results-driven, collaborative environment where your expertise and leadership directly impact product success.

 

THE PERSON:

 

You are a seasoned mechanical engineering design professional who is self-driven and highly proficient in electromechanical product design, integration, and validation for high performance computing hardware especially at the rack level server systems level, with optic and laser experience in the mix. You bring a demonstrated ability for innovation and continuous improvement throughout your career, as well as a track record of using your proven engineering expertise to drive best practices and value across an organization.

 

You bring excellent communication and interpersonal skills, a collaborative design mindset, and strong design tradeoff judgement. You actively listen to other perspectives, thoughtfully evaluate technical tradeoffs and are willing to adapt or rethink your own design approach to achieve the best overall solution. You thrive in a fast-paced environment where multiple engineering design teams work together to solve highly complex technical challenges.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

 

  • Collaborate with a global team to define, design, and integrate mechanical systems for server/compute products.
  • Lead mechanical development efforts across server design, system architecture, rack-level integration, cooling solutions, and laser and optics.
  • Champion Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Reliability (DFR) principles for high-volume production.
  • Participate in and lead design reviews, providing actionable feedback to improve product quality, reliability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Perform mechanical modeling in Creo, tolerance analysis, and system-level mechanical design tailored to AMD’s strategic market segments.
  • Contribute to post-silicon development through test planning, characterization, data analysis, and support of customer/reference systems.
  • Provide technical direction and mentorship to junior engineers; act as a key decision-maker in design reviews and cross-functional discussions.
  • Drive the continuous improvement of mechanical design processes and workflows.
  • Champion innovation by introducing new mechanical design concepts, technologies, and methodologies.
  • Use independent judgment and initiative to solve complex mechanical challenges and influence product direction.

 

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

 

Technical Leadership:

  • Advanced experience and demonstrated ability to manage and contribute to multiple technically diverse programs in parallel.
  • Highly proficient in leading complex engineering efforts from concept through production with a strong understanding of fabrication processes, tooling design, cost optimization, DFM/DFA (Design for Manufacturability and Assembly), and supplier collaboration from prototype through high-volume production.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; background of influencing and collaborating across internal teams, external vendors and partners, and geographies.
  • Experience leading by example and promoting a culture of teamwork and shared success

Technical Experience:

  • Deep understanding of mechanical materials, manufacturing processes (sheet metal, injection molding, die casting, extrusion), and industry standards.
  • Senior level experience in server and server infrastructure design is highly desired. Proficiency in developing mechanical solutions at the system level for semiconductor products is essential, including data analysis and product characterization.
  • Seasoned experience in mechanical design and development, at Senior/lead level in server and switch development field.
  • Advanced proficiency with CAD software such as Creo, SolidWorks, or equivalent, with advanced modeling and assembly management skills.
  • Proven expertise in the integration of silicon into system-level products, particularly in high-performance computing/server environments.
  • Advanced understanding of thermal management, cooling systems, mechanical modeling tools, and industry-standard design practices.
  • Mechanical Modeling: Advanced knowledge and demonstrated proficiency of statistical analysis, structural and tolerance analysis, and Finite Element Analysis (FEA). Proficiency in Creo.
  • Optics and laser experience is preferred.

Strategic Thinking:

  • Ability to drive the definition and implementation of highly complex mechanical solutions in a dynamic, high-tech environment with evolving business and technical priorities.

BS or MS in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

You have a proven track record of leading customer-facing technical teams, managing complex customer engagements, and driving successful deployment and sustainment of infrastructure at scale. 

You are equally comfortable engaging with customer executives, architects, operations teams, and engineering organizations while driving alignment across AMD. You possess strong technical credibility, customer advocacy skills, and the ability to lead through influence in complex environments. 

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 

  • Lead and scale the Cloud, HPC & Sovereign AI Customer Engineering organization supporting strategic customer deployments and lifecycle management.

  • Lead a team of Customer Program Managers responsible for customer engagement, deployment readiness, new product introduction (NPI) execution, production ramp, and fleet sustainment activities.

  • Drive successful deployment, adoption, and operational readiness of AMD compute and AI solutions across Cloud, HPC, and Sovereign AI customers.

  • Serve as the executive escalation point for strategic customer issues and drive resolution of complex deployment, platform, performance, and operational challenges.

  • Partner closely with Customer Platform Engineering teams, including PAE, BAE, Security Engineering, and Debug Engineering, to ensure successful customer outcomes.

  • Develop deployment methodologies, operational best practices, and customer engagement frameworks that accelerate customer time-to-production.

  • Drive fleet sustainment strategies including observability, telemetry, remote diagnostics, lifecycle management, and operational readiness.

data.description:

THE ROLE: 

 

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically exceptional PMTS AI/ML Compiler Engineer to join AMD's AI Software organization. In this role, you will drive compiler and performance optimizations that enable state-of-the-art AI training and inference workloads on AMD GPU platforms. You will work at the intersection of compiler technology, machine learning frameworks, GPU architecture, and performance engineering, contributing to the ROCm software ecosystem and ONNX Runtime execution stack. The ideal candidate combines deep compiler expertise with hands-on experience optimizing AI workloads, and thrives in a fast-paced environment collaborating across architecture, kernel, runtime, and framework teams.

 

THE PERSON: 

 

You are passionate about building high-performance AI software and solving complex optimization challenges. You possess strong compiler fundamentals, GPU programming expertise, and a proven ability to improve performance for large-scale AI models.

WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING 

At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond.  Together, we advance your career.  




The Role: 

We are looking for our next team member to help drive a new era of computing into the datacenter & commercial clients for enterprise accounts by engaging with key end users and platform and partners to demonstrate AMD technology differentiators addressing their business needs in real world usage scenarios. To be responsible for providing technical support to commercial end user accounts within their defined region(s) or vertical market(s). This position is accountable to the commercial sales team and the field engineering director for all aspects of technical engagements required to support sales and account objectives. The ideal team member will also occasionally provide training to teammates and assist them with their own unique challenges.  

   

The FAE will cultivate a deep technical understanding of client, workstation or server processor architecture, operating systems (Windows / Linux) or hypervisors (ESXi, KVM, Hyper-V) and application software. The successful FAE will leverage the synthesis of this knowledge to understand application performance at the system up to datacenter level and guide the customer.  

  

The Person: 

  • Pre-Sales experience:  strong ability to translate complex technical architectures into clear value propositions for enterprise customers. 

  • Knowledge on commercial clients (desktop/laptops) or server (cpu or gpu) at hardware & Operating System levels. System administrator experience is a plus. 

  • A good balance of hardware, system architecture and software expertise 

  • Ability to cultivate strong internal (sales, marketing, engineering) and external (customer) relationships. Demonstrated history of success in developing and maintaining such relationships. 

  • Hands-on experience in the setup and configuration/deployment of systems  

  • Proven experience as a senior level engineer (or equivalent technical role) 

  • Native speaker of the country where the position is offered. Capacity to also present and handle business and technical discussions in English. 

  • Willing to learn 

  

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Articulate AMD based technology offerings across multiple market verticals  

  • Provide hands-on, expert-level technical assistance to end-users & partners 

  • Partner with other AMD and vendor subject matter experts to build specific customer solutions  

  • Analyze vendor product solutions and evaluate product performance based on customer needs  

  • Provide technical assistance to sales in the design and integration of customer applications using AMD based solutions  

  • Install and test solutions in-house, as required, to ensure successful deployments and evaluations  

  • Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions that are aligned with end-user objectives  

  • Design and manage the execution of evaluations to ensure a quality solution is delivered  

  • Capture a solid understanding of the competitive landscape and clearly articulate the technical differentiation and value proposition associated with AMD versus its competitors 

  

  

Preferred Experience: 

  • Demonstrated knowledge in one or more market verticals including datacenter virtualization, high performance computing, workstation, or commercial clients.  

  • Proven understanding of client or server software ecosystem in one or more areas including OS/hypervisors. 

  • Good working knowledge of client or server hardware ecosystem 

  • Experience in application/workload profiling, tuning and performance assessment is a plus  

  • Experience in workstation or datacenter Graphics (Professional ISV, AI/ML, GPGPU) is a plus  

  

Academic Credentials: 

Bachelor’s degree in a Technical discipline or equivalent (Computer Science or Electrical Engineering preferred)  

  

Location: 

Sweden: Stockholm preferred 

  

Travel: 

40%
